items.name: firefly-base
items.title: Firefly Base v1
items.description: Install this first in every site. Design tokens for Tailwind v4, the scroll-reveal system, parallax, art-scale, the button set (pill buttons, round icon buttons, switch tabs, pagination dots), the hero CTA pair, a two-tone headline helper and a content-free visual placeholder.

items.name: navigation-sticky-v1
items.title: Navigation Sticky v1
items.description: Fixed header with a brand, text links and a primary pill. Turns translucent and compacts after a few pixels of scroll; on mobile a hamburger opens a simple panel.

items.name: navigation-slide-out-v1
items.title: Navigation Slide-out v1
items.description: Fixed header with a brand, text links, a quiet secondary link, a primary pill and a dot-grid menu button on every breakpoint. The button opens a right-side panel that slides in over a dimmed page: big primary links, the CTA again and small link groups at the bottom. Compacts on scroll like Navigation Sticky.

items.name: hero-centered-v1
items.title: Hero Centered v1
items.description: Centred copy with a stacked two-tone h1, optional eyebrow and body, the dark + ghost CTA pair, and a large visual underneath. The copy reveals line by line on load; the visual follows and drifts down as it scrolls out.

items.name: hero-split-v1
items.title: Hero Split v1
items.description: Copy on one side, visual on the other: left-aligned two-tone h1, optional eyebrow, body and mono note, the dark + ghost CTA pair. Stacks copy-first on mobile; `reverse` puts the visual on the left.

items.name: hero-portrait-v1
items.title: Hero Portrait v1
items.description: Portrait visual on the left, copy on the right: a two-tone h1 that reveals word by word, a short body and the CTA pair. Full-width visual on mobile, side by side from tablet.

items.name: hero-news-bento-v1
items.title: Hero News Bento v1
items.description: Editorial front page: masthead with a stacked two-tone h1 and intro, then a bento of stories — one large lead card with the image behind a dark gradient and 3–5 smaller cards with kicker, title and an optional image slot.

items.name: feature-row-interactive-v1
items.title: Feature Row Interactive v1
items.description: Two-tone headline and a list of steps on one side, a 720×560 visual frame on the other. The steps are an accordion: one open at a time, and opening a step crossfades the frame to that step's visual.

items.name: feature-row-checks-v1
items.title: Feature Row Checks v1
items.description: Compact two-tone headline and a static list of ✓ + title + body items on one side, one 720×560 visual on the other. Every item is open; nothing collapses.

items.name: lenses-list-v1
items.title: Lenses List v1
items.description: Two-tone headline with a portrait visual under it, next to a list of large clickable names. The active name is black with a short description, the others grey; choosing one crossfades the visual.

items.name: stats-rows-v1
items.title: Stats Rows v1
items.description: Two-tone headline with an optional eyebrow, intro and ghost pill above a list of hairline-separated rows: a large value or step number on the left, a title and short description on the right. Three columns from tablet up, stacked on mobile.

items.name: steps-cards-v1
items.title: Steps Cards v1
items.description: A process in a row: two-tone heading with a short intro on the right, then one bordered card per step with an icon slot (numbered tile by default), title and body. Side by side on desktop, a 3-column grid on tablet, hairline rows on mobile.

items.name: stats-grid-v1
items.title: Stats Grid v1
items.description: Dark (or light) results section: an optional two-tone heading, an optional large quote with attribution, and a grid of 3–4 big numbers with a hairline above each. Two columns on mobile, one column per stat from tablet up.

items.name: before-after-compare-v1
items.title: Before/After Compare v1
items.description: Two-tone headline above two rounded panels: a neutral “before” panel with dash-marked pain points and a dark “after” panel with check-marked gains. Each panel has a mono label, a visual slot and an optional lead line. Side by side from tablet up, stacked on mobile.

items.name: carousel-coverflow-v1
items.title: Carousel Coverflow v1
items.description: Two-tone headline over a cover-flow of portrait cards: the centre card full size, the neighbours smaller and faded. Round prev/next buttons, pagination dots with a sliding line for the active card, click a side card, arrow keys, mouse and touch drag with snap and flick, and autoplay with a visible pause button that is off under reduced motion.

items.name: logo-marquee-v1
items.title: Logo Marquee v1
items.description: A compact strip of logos sliding sideways on a CSS transform loop, with an optional mono eyebrow and soft edge fades. One row, or two rows moving in opposite directions; pauses on hover and stands still under reduced motion.

items.name: bento-cards-v1
items.title: Bento Cards v1
items.description: Two-tone headline and a grid of equal-height cards in three tones: a photo filling the card under a gradient, a dark surface or a light surface with a visual slot in the middle. One column on mobile, two on tablet, four on desktop (three for 5–6 cards). Cards lift on hover and can be links.

items.name: testimonial-quote-v1
items.title: Testimonial Quote v1
items.description: One large centred quote with a 48px avatar, name and role, on a dark or light background. Optional mono eyebrow and company mark; eyebrow, quote and attribution fade in one after another.

items.name: faq-split-v1
items.title: FAQ Split v1
items.description: Two-tone headline and a ghost button on the left, accordion on the right. One question open at a time, the first open by default, with a rotating +/– glyph.

items.name: faq-centered-v1
items.title: FAQ Centered v1
items.description: Two-tone headline on top, a centred accordion (640px tablet / 760px desktop) below and a contact line with a ghost pill at the bottom. One question open at a time, the first open by default, with a rotating +/– glyph.

items.name: cta-demo-pill-v1
items.title: CTA Demo Pill v1
items.description: Centred closing call to action: a small mono pill tag, a big two-tone heading, a short body, the primary + ghost button pair and a small note. Optional product visual below in a rounded frame with a 30px parallax. Dark or light.

items.name: cta-newsletter-v1
items.title: CTA Newsletter v1
items.description: Centred email sign-up: two-tone heading, one line of body and a pill form with a labelled email field and a dark submit button. The confirmation appears in a reserved status slot, so nothing shifts. Optional ticked benefits and a visual slot. Nothing is sent until a backend is connected.

items.name: footer-v1
items.title: Footer v1
items.description: Dark footer with a top hairline: brand and tagline, link columns and an email sign-up form with an inline confirmation. Stacked on mobile, brand and columns side by side on tablet, three columns on desktop. Optional legal line.
